story.totalsLine: Across these 10 events the National Weather Service recorded 15 deaths, 157 injuries and $113.1 million in recorded damage.

sentences.text: The most significant event in the record for this area is the Sharkey County tornado of Mar 24, 2023, which the National Weather Service recorded with 14 deaths, 150 injuries and $83,136,000 in damage.
On Aug 29, 2005, Hurricane Katrina affected your zone, MSZ041, with $15,400,000 in recorded damage and no deaths or injuries.
A Thunderstorm Wind event on May 4, 2006 blew part of the roof off South Delta Middle School in Anguilla, and several homes and businesses in Rolling Fork "sustained damage."
Tornadoes struck the county on Apr 24, 2010, Oct 17, 2012 and Dec 13, 2022; the 2012 tornado injured 4 people and the 2022 tornado injured 3, with several mobile homes rolled and destroyed.
On Jan 14, 2024, a winter storm covered area roads with sleet and ice, and the record says a 32-year old man walking home was later found to have died from hypothermia.
Altogether, the National Weather Service recorded 312 weather events in this area since 2000, including 68 Thunderstorm Wind and 21 Tornado events.

SE-1102153.title: Tornado, Mar 24, 2023
SE-1102153.origin: NCEI Storm Events, as filed by the National Weather Service
SE-1102153.text: Tornado on Mar 24, 2023 in SHARKEY (county MSC125). Deaths: 14. Injuries: 150. Recorded damage: $83,136,000 (about $83.1 million).
SE-1102153.quote: This long track, violent tornado began over northern |Issaquena County near Grant Rd, downing multiple trees and damaging |two older outbuildings. It tracked northeastward, producing tree |damage as it crossed the Steele Bayou Canal before crossing into |Sharkey County. At this point, the tornado began to substantially |increase in size and intensity. A very high percentage of trees were |snapped along the path through a wooded area south of Bear Lake Rd. |It was in this wooded area where the first indications of EF3 to EF4 |damage were noted, with at least one tree and root ball and several |more large tree pieces fully displaced into the downstream field. |From this point along the path in Sharkey County, there was a well |defined confluence zone in damage along the center of the tornado |track.

SE-5471471.title: Hurricane (Typhoon), Aug 29, 2005
SE-5471471.origin: NCEI Storm Events, as filed by the National Weather Service
SE-5471471.text: Hurricane (Typhoon) on Aug 29, 2005 in Sharkey (forecast zone MSZ041, YOUR zone: the address is inside it). Deaths: 0. Injuries: 0. Recorded damage: $15,400,000 (about $15.4 million).
SE-5471471.quote: Hurricane Katrina will likely go down as the worst and costliest natural disaster in United States history. The amount of destruction, the cost of damaged property/agriculture and the large loss of life across the affected region has been overwhelming. Catastrophic damage was widespread across a large portion of the Gulf Coast region. The devastation was not only confined to the coastal region, widespread and significant damage occurred well inland up to the Hattiesburg area and northward past Interstate 20. This hurricane has changed life as we know it across the Gulf Coast region which will take many years to return to normal.Hurricane Katrina was a very large and powerful storm which set several unfortunate records. This storm began as Tropical Depression 12 during the late afternoon and evening of August 23rd.

SE-5505502.title: Thunderstorm Wind, May 4, 2006
SE-5505502.origin: NCEI Storm Events, as filed by the National Weather Service
SE-5505502.text: Thunderstorm Wind on May 4, 2006 in SHARKEY (county MSC125). Deaths: 0. Injuries: 0. Recorded damage: $700,000. Recorded magnitude: 60 (EG).
SE-5505502.quote: South Delta Middle School, in Anguilla, had a portion of its roof blown off along with many trees blown down and numerous large limbs broken and laid in area lawns and streets. Additionally, the damaging winds extended southward into Rolling Fork where several homes and businesses sustained damage.

SE-224550.title: Tornado, Apr 24, 2010
SE-224550.origin: NCEI Storm Events, as filed by the National Weather Service
SE-224550.text: Tornado on Apr 24, 2010 in SHARKEY (county MSC125). Deaths: 0. Injuries: 0. Recorded damage: $2,000,000 (about $2 million).
SE-224550.quote: The path of the tornado clipped the far southeast corner of Sharkey County in the Delta National Forest. Considerable damage occurred to the timber along the path as it moved into western Yazoo County. The tornado reached EF2 intensity before moving into western Yazoo County with peak winds around 130 mph.

SE-413060.title: Tornado, Oct 17, 2012
SE-413060.origin: NCEI Storm Events, as filed by the National Weather Service
SE-413060.text: Tornado on Oct 17, 2012 in SHARKEY (county MSC125). Deaths: 0. Injuries: 4. Recorded damage: $200,000.
SE-413060.quote: Several mobile homes were heavily damaged or destroyed, and dozens of power poles were snapped. Maximum winds were estimated at 125 mph. The tornado continued into Humphreys County.

SE-1077241.title: Tornado, Dec 13, 2022
SE-1077241.origin: NCEI Storm Events, as filed by the National Weather Service
SE-1077241.text: Tornado on Dec 13, 2022 in SHARKEY (county MSC125). Deaths: 0. Injuries: 3. Recorded damage: $1,000,000 (about $1 million).
SE-1077241.quote: A tornado touched down north of Rolling Fork Road where a few trees had limbs damaged. The tornado intensified quickly as it traveled northeast across Garfield Rd. and destroyed numerous outbuildings. The tornado reached its maximum intensity as it crossed Rolling Fork Rd. and destroyed a well-constructed outbuilding after pulling out concrete anchors weighing several hundred pounds. The concrete was lofted and carried about 50 yards before landing on the pavement. The tornado continued northeastward, with some fluctuation in strength as it damaged numerous trees and caused primarily roof damage to homes. As the tornado crossed US Highway 61, several mobile homes were rolled and destroyed. In this group of homes, three injuries were reported. The tornado weakened and lifted shortly after over farmland. The maximum width was 250 yards. The maximum wind speed was 125 mph.

SE-1159861.title: Winter Storm, Jan 14, 2024
SE-1159861.origin: NCEI Storm Events, as filed by the National Weather Service
SE-1159861.text: Winter Storm on Jan 14, 2024 in Sharkey (forecast zone MSZ041, YOUR zone: the address is inside it). Deaths: 1. Injuries: 0. No damage figure was recorded.
SE-1159861.quote: Accumulations of about one half inch of sleet fell across the county, but light snow and freezing rain also fell. Area roads were covered by the sleet and glaze of ice. A 32-year old man who was walking home during the winter storm was later found to have died from hypothermia near South Delta Elementary School. Temperatures below freezing and wind chills as low as -10 degrees Fahrenheit occurred during and after the winter storm.
